subject: Charged twice for same order
body: Hi, I just noticed my credit card was charged twice for order #92041. Both charges appeared on March 15th. Please refund the duplicate charge immediately.

subject: Password reset not working
body: I've tried resetting my password 5 times today and I keep getting an error. I have an important meeting tomorrow and I need access to my account. Please help urgently.

subject: Just checking in
body: Hey team, I placed an order last week for the Pro Headset. No rush, just wanted to confirm it's on its way. Thanks!

subject: RE: RE: RE: still no resolution
body: I have been going back and forth with your team for 3 weeks. If this is not resolved by end of day today I will be filing a complaint with the consumer protection agency and disputing via PayPal. Order #71902. I am done waiting.

subject: Wrong size delivered
body: My order #80512 arrived Monday but I received a size M jacket instead of the size L I ordered. I need the correct size — can you ship a replacement or should I return this first?

subject: Wow
body: Oh wow, truly incredible service. Three weeks for a delivery that was promised in 3-5 days. And when it finally arrived, the box was crushed. Just stellar work all around.

subject: Partnership opportunity

subject: commande non reçue
body: Bonjour, j'ai passé une commande il y a 10 jours (numéro #66321) et je n'ai toujours rien reçu. Pouvez-vous vérifier le statut de ma livraison? Merci.
